auth.description:
Connect to your Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP instance using Basic Authentication.

**Required:**
- **Server URL**: Your Oracle Fusion instance URL (e.g., https://your-instance.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com)
- **Username**: Your Oracle Cloud username with API access
- **Password**: Your Oracle Cloud password

Contact your Oracle administrator if you need REST API access enabled.

serverUrl.description: Your Oracle Fusion Cloud instance URL (e.g., https://your-instance.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com)

create_invoice.name: create_invoice
create_invoice.description: Creates a new payables invoice in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

invoiceNumber.description: Unique invoice number from the supplier.

businessUnit.description: The business unit name for the invoice.

supplier.description: The supplier name on the invoice.

supplierSite.description: The supplier site from where goods/services are rendered.

termsDate.description: Date used with payment terms to calculate due dates (YYYY-MM-DD).

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms used to calculate due dates.

invoiceGroup.description: Group name for reporting and payment purposes.

requester.description: Name of the person who requested the goods or services.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new payables (supplier) invoice, requiring invoice number, business unit, supplier and supplier site, amount, currencies, key dates, and payment method. Not idempotent: each call inserts a new invoice and repeats create duplicates (the supplier invoice number is not deduplicated here). Use for bills you owe suppliers; for customer billing use Create Receivables Invoice instead.

get_invoice.name: get_invoice
get_invoice.description: Retrieves details of a specific payables invoice by ID.

invoiceId.description: The unique identifier of the invoice (InvoiceId or invoicesUniqID).

aiMetadata.description: Fetch one payables (supplier) invoice by its InvoiceId. Read-only and idempotent. Use when you already have the payables invoice ID; to look one up by number, supplier, or status use Find Invoices first. Distinct from Get Receivables Invoice, which retrieves customer-billing (AR) invoices.

find_invoices.name: find_invoices
find_invoices.description: Search for payables invoices with optional filters.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 25, max: 500).

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

aiMetadata.description: List or search payables (supplier) invoices, optionally filtering by invoice number, supplier, business unit, or validation status, with limit/offset paging (default 25, max 500). Read-only and idempotent. Use to discover supplier bills or resolve an InvoiceId; for customer-billing invoices use Find Receivables Invoices instead.

update_invoice.name: update_invoice
update_invoice.description: Updates an existing payables invoice. Note: Only certain attributes can be updated and cascade defaulting does not apply.

invoiceId.description: The unique identifier of the invoice to update.

aiMetadata.description: Modify an existing payables (supplier) invoice by InvoiceId; only a limited set of fields (description, payment terms, pay group, invoice group, payment method, remittance messages) can be changed and cascade defaulting does not apply. At least one field must be supplied or the call fails. Effectively idempotent since it sets the given values.

delete_invoice.name: delete_invoice
delete_invoice.description: Deletes a payables invoice from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

invoiceId.description: The unique identifier of the invoice to delete.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete a payables (supplier) invoice by its InvoiceId. Destructive; idempotent in effect since a removed invoice cannot be deleted again. Oracle typically allows deletion only for unvalidated/unpaid invoices; to back out a validated invoice without removing it use Cancel Invoice instead.

validate_invoice.name: validate_invoice
validate_invoice.description: Validates a payables invoice in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

invoiceId.description: The unique identifier of the invoice to validate.

aiMetadata.description: Run Oracle validation on a payables (supplier) invoice by InvoiceId, checking it and applying any holds so it can proceed to payment. State-changing but effectively idempotent: re-validating an already-validated invoice has no further effect. Use before paying a supplier bill; this does not create or cancel the invoice.

cancel_invoice.name: cancel_invoice
cancel_invoice.description: Cancels a payables invoice in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

invoiceId.description: The unique identifier of the invoice to cancel.

aiMetadata.description: Cancel a payables (supplier) invoice by InvoiceId, voiding its amount so it is no longer payable. State-changing; effectively idempotent since an already-cancelled invoice stays cancelled, though a paid or validated invoice may be rejected by Oracle. Use to back out a supplier bill in place; to remove it entirely use Delete Invoice.

create_receivables_invoice.name: create_receivables_invoice
create_receivables_invoice.description: Creates a new receivables (AR) invoice in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

businessUnit.description: The business unit under which the invoice is created.

transactionType.description: The transaction type assigned to the invoice.

transactionSource.description: The transaction source assigned to the invoice.

transactionNumber.description: The transaction number assigned to the invoice. If not provided, it will be auto-generated.

transactionDate.description: The date when the invoice was created (YYYY-MM-DD).

accountingDate.description: The accounting date assigned to the invoice (YYYY-MM-DD).

billToCustomerNumber.description: The account number of the bill-to customer.

billToCustomerName.description: The name of the bill-to customer.

billToSite.description: The number that identifies the bill-to customer site.

invoiceCurrencyCode.description: The currency code of the invoice (e.g., USD, EUR).

paymentTerms.description: The payment terms assigned to the invoice.

dueDate.description: The date when the invoice is due (YYYY-MM-DD).

purchaseOrder.description: The purchase order number on the invoice.

invoiceStatus.description: The completion status of the invoice. Must be Complete when creating.

shipToCustomerNumber.description: The registry identifier of the ship-to customer.

shipToCustomerName.description: The name of the customer who receives the goods or services.

legalEntityIdentifier.description: The unique identifier of the legal entity.

crossReference.description: The reference field default value from the transaction source.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new accounts-receivable (customer-billing) invoice, requiring at minimum a business unit, transaction type, and bill-to customer account number. Not idempotent: each call creates a new invoice, and an omitted transaction number is auto-generated, so re-running produces duplicates. Use for billing customers; for supplier bills you owe, use Create Invoice (payables) instead.

get_receivables_invoice.name: get_receivables_invoice
get_receivables_invoice.description: Retrieves details of a specific receivables invoice by ID.

customerTransactionId.description: The unique identifier of the receivables invoice.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch one accounts-receivable (customer) invoice by its CustomerTransactionId. Read-only and idempotent. Use when you already have the AR invoice ID; to look one up by transaction number, customer, or date range use Find Receivables Invoices first. Distinct from Get Invoice, which retrieves payables (supplier) invoices.

find_receivables_invoices.name: find_receivables_invoices
find_receivables_invoices.description: Search for receivables invoices with optional filters.

billToCustomerNumber.description: Filter by bill-to customer account number.

billingDateFrom.description: Filter invoices with billing date on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

billingDateTo.description: Filter invoices with billing date on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 25, max: 500).

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

aiMetadata.description: List or search accounts-receivable (customer) invoices, optionally filtering by transaction number, bill-to customer, status, or a billing-date range, with limit/offset paging (default 25, max 500). Read-only and idempotent. Use this to discover AR invoices or resolve a CustomerTransactionId; for payables (supplier) invoices use Find Invoices instead.

update_receivables_invoice.name: update_receivables_invoice
update_receivables_invoice.description: Updates an existing receivables invoice. Note: Only InvoiceStatus, PaymentTerms, and TransactionDate can be updated.

customerTransactionId.description: The unique identifier of the receivables invoice to update.

invoiceStatus.description: The completion status of the invoice.

paymentTerms.description: The payment terms assigned to the invoice.

transactionDate.description: The date when the invoice was created (YYYY-MM-DD).

aiMetadata.description: Modify an existing accounts-receivable invoice identified by CustomerTransactionId; only invoice status, payment terms, and transaction date are editable. At least one field must be supplied or the call fails. Effectively idempotent since it sets fields to the values given. The invoice must already exist; use Create Receivables Invoice to add a new one.

delete_receivables_invoice.name: delete_receivables_invoice
delete_receivables_invoice.description: Deletes a receivables invoice from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

customerTransactionId.description: The unique identifier of the receivables invoice to delete.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete an accounts-receivable (customer) invoice by its CustomerTransactionId. Destructive; idempotent in effect since a deleted invoice cannot be deleted again (re-running on a missing ID errors). Use only when the invoice should be fully removed rather than corrected; to change status or fields use Update Receivables Invoice.

create_payment.name: create_payment
create_payment.description: Creates a new manual payment in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

businessUnit.description: The business unit name for the payment.

paymentNumber.description: The check number printed on physical check.

paymentDate.description: The date when the payment is made (YYYY-MM-DD).

paymentCurrency.description: The currency in which payment is made (e.g., USD).

paymentMethodCode.description: The payment method code (e.g., CHECK, EFT).

payee.description: The party name to whom payment is made.

payeeSite.description: The supplier site name to whom payment is made.

paymentDocument.description: The name of the payment document.

paymentDescription.description: The user description for the payment.

disbursementBankAccountName.description: The name of the internal bank account from where the payment is made.

remitToAccountNumber.description: The supplier's bank account number for electronic payment.

conversionRateType.description: The type of conversion rate used for foreign currency payments.

conversionRate.description: The conversion rate for foreign currency payments.

addressLine1.description: The first address line of party to whom the payment is made.

city.description: The city name of the party to whom the payment is made.

state.description: The state name of the party to whom the payment is made.

country.description: The country name of the party to whom the payment is made.

zip.description: The postal code of the party to whom the payment is made.

aiMetadata.description: Record a manual payables payment (e.g. a check or EFT), requiring business unit, payment number, date, currency, and payment method. Not idempotent: each call records a new payment and re-running issues a duplicate. Use to disburse funds to a payee; to reverse a payment use Void Payment, or Stop Payment to halt one before it clears.

get_payment.name: get_payment
get_payment.description: Retrieves details of a specific payment by Check ID.

checkId.description: The unique identifier of the payment.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch one payables payment by its CheckId. Read-only and idempotent. Use when you already have the payment/check identifier to inspect its status, amount, or payee before voiding or stopping it.

find_payments.name: find_payments
find_payments.description: Search for payments with optional filters.

paymentDateFrom.description: Filter payments on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

paymentDateTo.description: Filter payments on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 25, max: 500).

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

aiMetadata.description: Read-only search of Oracle Fusion accounts-payable payments, optionally filtered by payment number, payee, business unit, status (Negotiable, Voided, Stopped, Cleared), or a payment-date range, with limit/offset paging. Use to look up or list payments; it never modifies data. To change a payment use Update Payment instead.

update_payment.name: update_payment
update_payment.description: Updates descriptive and global flexfields for a payment.

checkId.description: The unique identifier of the payment to update.

voidDate.description: The date when the payment is voided (YYYY-MM-DD).

voidAccountingDate.description: The date when the voided payment is accounted (YYYY-MM-DD).

aiMetadata.description: Update an existing Oracle Fusion accounts-payable payment identified by its Check ID, setting its description and/or void dates (void date and void accounting date). Requires the payment to already exist and at least one field to change; only the supplied fields are modified, so reapplying the same values leaves the payment unchanged.

stop_payment.name: stop_payment
stop_payment.description: Initiates a stop payment request for a payment.

checkId.description: The unique identifier of the payment to stop.

stopReason.description: The reason for stopping the payment.

stopReference.description: A reference for the stop payment request.

aiMetadata.description: Place a stop-payment request on an issued payables payment by CheckId, with an optional reason and reference, to prevent it from being cashed. State-changing; effectively idempotent since repeating the request leaves the payment stopped. Use when a payment has gone out but should not clear; to fully reverse one already cleared use Void Payment instead.

void_payment.name: void_payment
void_payment.description: Voids a payment by setting the void date.

checkId.description: The unique identifier of the payment to void.

voidDate.description: The date when the payment is voided (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

voidAccountingDate.description: The date when the voided payment is accounted (YYYY-MM-DD).

aiMetadata.description: Void an already-issued payables payment by CheckId, setting its void date (defaults to today) and optional void accounting date. State-changing; effectively idempotent since a voided payment stays voided. Use to reverse a payment that has been issued; to prevent one from clearing before it is cashed use Stop Payment instead.

get_journal_batch.name: get_journal_batch
get_journal_batch.description: Retrieves details of a specific journal batch by ID.

jeBatchId.description: The unique identifier of the journal batch.

expand.description: Select child resources to include in the response.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch one general-ledger journal batch by its JeBatchId, optionally expanding child resources such as journal headers, errors, action logs, attachments, or descriptive flexfields. Read-only and idempotent. Use when you already have the batch ID; to search by name, status, or period use Find Journal Batches first.

find_journal_batches.name: find_journal_batches
find_journal_batches.description: Search for journal batches with optional filters.

createdBy.description: Filter by the user who created the batch.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 25, max: 500).

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

aiMetadata.description: List or search general-ledger journal batches, optionally filtering by batch name, status (unposted/posted/error), period, journal source, or creator, with limit/offset paging (default 25, max 500). Read-only and idempotent. Use to discover batches or resolve a JeBatchId before fetching or updating a specific batch.

update_journal_batch.name: update_journal_batch
update_journal_batch.description: Updates batch completion status and reversal attributes. Note: Only status and reversal attributes can be updated.

jeBatchId.description: The unique identifier of the journal batch to update.

reversalFlag.description: Indicates whether to reverse all journals in the batch.

reversalDate.description: The reversal date for the journals in the batch (YYYY-MM-DD).

reversalPeriod.description: The reversal period for the journals in the batch.

reversalMethodMeaning.description: The reversal method for the journals in the batch.

aiMetadata.description: Modify a general-ledger journal batch identified by JeBatchId; only its status and reversal attributes (reverse flag, reversal date/period/method) are editable. At least one field must be supplied or the call fails. Effectively idempotent since it sets the given fields. The batch must already exist; use Find Journal Batches to locate it.

delete_journal_batch.name: delete_journal_batch
delete_journal_batch.description: Deletes a journal batch from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

jeBatchId.description: The unique identifier of the journal batch to delete.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete a general-ledger journal batch by its JeBatchId. Destructive; idempotent in effect since a removed batch cannot be deleted again. Typically only unposted batches can be removed; use when discarding a draft batch rather than correcting it (use Update Journal Batch to change status or reversal attributes).
